landing-06-faq-title-claim: Questions teams ask at first look.
landing-06-faq-0-question: Can I run this alongside another scheduling tool?
landing-06-faq-0-answer: Yes. Teams usually run both for a short period while they move workflows. You can keep an external tool connected while shifting teams over profile by profile.
landing-06-faq-1-question: What does onboarding require before I can draft?
landing-06-faq-1-answer: You need one project team and one profile, then your workflow settings and approvals can be added in the same screen.
landing-06-faq-2-answer: Approvals are first-class actions in the post lifecycle. Every change keeps context and the history of who approved it.
landing-06-faq-3-question: What support is available if I get stuck?
landing-06-faq-3-answer: Today, PublyApp is free while in beta, but no trial support flow is active yet. A free trial is planned before general availability; its support terms have not been published.
landing-06-faq-4-question: Is my client's data isolated from other clients?
landing-06-faq-4-answer: Yes. Each profile carries its own membership and permission set, and a person who is not a member of a profile cannot see or act on it.
landing-06-faq-5-question: What does it cost while PublyApp is in beta?
landing-06-faq-5-answer: Nothing. There is no billing system running today. Prices shown on this page are indicative and a free trial is planned before general availability.
